author: jessica
source: Eliza's letter 2026-10-26 (office/correspondence/2026-10-26-eliza-jessica-infestations-for-the-board.md), on his week goal: "This week I'd like to have at least one of each of the new missions set and the old in the legacy nodes."
_note: THE INFESTATION FAMILY, 2 OF 2: SOMETHING NESTED INSIDE. His MB17 (interior predators, 5 originals), with a job:
the creatures have settled round the control terminal in the middle of a dungeon, the crew pulled out, and the air
scrubbers are off. Get to the terminal through them and restart the scrubbers so the crew can come back.
who: infested round beat 1's object, one species, set to attack, placed when he first comes within 250 m.
⚠ Step one's marker is INSIDE, so both the broadcast's arrival hook and the infested placement measure through a load
door. 04a put its step one outside for exactly this reason. Unproven; Eliza's to say whether it fires.

place._theme: A built dungeon (as 04a), not a cave: scrubbers and a terminal want a built interior.

prose.name: Infestation: Creatures in the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Something nested in the middle of the <Place> and the crew pulled out. The air scrubbers have been off since.
prose.card: Infestation contract. Something has nested in the <Place> on <Planet>, and the crew pulled out. Get to the control terminal and restart the air scrubbers. Expect company. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Restart the air scrubbers at the <Place>
beats.journal: Creatures had nested round the control terminal in the middle of the <Place>. I got through them and restarted the air scrubbers, so the crew can come back.
beats.name: Scrubber Control
say: That's the scrubbers back on, so the crew can come back now.

broadcast: The control terminal's in the middle of the place, and that's where they've settled. Right on top of it. Get it running again and we can send the crew back in.
_speech: A foreman who left in a hurry and is not proud of it. Hector, already in two recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
